title: When the Weather Breaks
author: Ines Halloran
blurb: Dominic Iversen, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
